title: Freeze strict XML applicability and offline reference contract
api_or_output: Immutable full-corpus applicability ledger and executable offline reference/comparison contract

acceptance.description: Publish executable complete per-case applicability/expected-outcome classification for all 2585 original IDs and exact byte/resource identities against XML1.0 Fifth Edition, Namespaces1.0 Third Edition, nonvalidating obligations and frozen optional encoding profile. Preserve M1 metadata/bytes; precisely justify historical-edition, invalid, optional-error, namespace-disabled and encoding cases; no blanket exclusions or hiding product failures.

Freeze independent semantic comparison/source-URI/offline resource mapping and disagreement-evidence contract. Narrowly extend BCL runner existing options for explicit absolute source URI so relative/nested offline resources resolve without network/file access; preserve existing wire shapes/defaults and reject unknown/malformed options. Exercise representative successful/rejected/reference-limit cases and infrastructure negative controls with actual full-source runner identities.

Demonstrate independently compiled/executed classification/reference contract and representative model checks using verified prerequisites; preserve earlier tests/API/runner protocol behavior. Keep all remaining actual product failures visible for grammar child/final join, with concise summaries and transient-output cleanup; do not claim full product conformance.

requests: Explicit ordered ownership of BCL Program.cs and additive M2OfflineSourceTests.cs only; no ReferenceProtocol contract/public wire shape, shared project/package or M1 corpus inventory/manifest edits. Existing options dictionary may carry a narrowly specified explicit source URI. Route any required outside-path change to coordinator.

Use pinned complete offline resources; verify paths/hashes and reject traversal/symlink/corruption/missing data. Missing/denied resources and runner failures are infrastructure failures, never passing XML rejection or product exclusions. Reference capability limitations remain distinct from Xemele support.

Current M1 inventory labels are historical evidence, not an M2 applicability oracle. Exact changed-edition and nonvalidating expectations require normative justification; disagreements need exact case/hash/engine/runtime/protocol evidence. No timing/allocation workload or performance-policy changes required for this contract-only assignment.
